course.title: Acoustics and Lighting
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: Describe the reverberation time. A classroom, 80ft long by 50ft wide by 15ft high has sound absorption coefficient α's of 0.30 for walls, 0.04 for ceiling and 0.10 for floor. All a's are at 600 Hz. Find the reverberation time T at 600 Hz if 65% of the ceiling surface (along the perimeter of the room) is treated with acoustical panels at α of 0.85.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
